decisions.reason: The water phantom for particle therapy extends the firm's existing dosimetry QA knowledge, and after initial market experience the firm can assimilate feedback and improve it, making a drop unlikely.
This small-volume ionization chamber remains close to the firm's core dosimetry and calibration expertise, enabling effective learning and continued refinement.
As another small-volume chamber within established measurement capabilities, the firm can interpret early results and keep improving it.
The standard clinical ionization chamber line aligns closely with existing clinical dosimetry products, giving strong absorptive capacity and the lowest drop probability.
Relative dosimetry chambers fall within the firm's established calibration and measurement knowledge, so it can learn from results and continue to support the product.
Thimble ionization chambers are a classic dosimetry product the firm can readily support and enhance based on its existing related knowledge.
